name: Björn Verse
headline: Policy Advisor 'Noise Abatement' @ German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Protection, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)
summary:
Policy Advisor 'Noise Abatement' at the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Protection, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN).

Focusing on the evaluation and amendment of the Federal Aircraft Noise Protection Act (Gesetz zum Schutz gegen Fluglärm, FluLärmG) and corresponding Regulations (Fluglärmschutzverordnungen, FlugLSVen) as well as the EU Environmental Noise Directive and its national implementation. 

Ph.D. Scholar in Economic Sciences at the Faculty of Business and Economics, Chair of Sustainability Management and Environmental Accounting of the Technische Universität Dresden.

company.tagline: At BMUKN, we work for a healthy environment, nature conservation, climate action and consumer protection.
company.description: Protecting the climate, biodiversity and natural ressources - this is what the Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN) has been committed to for  40 years. Our work focuses on measures for clean waters, intact soils and low-pollutant air, as well as the promotion of environmentally friendly mobility and climate-friendly technologies. Our staff of more than 1.000 comes from a wide range of professions and personal backgrounds.
